draft.emotion: professional and calm, reassuring a patient who is slightly nervous
notes: Literally 'doctor of teeth' (an iḍāfa construction). To make it definite, add الـ only to the second word: طَبِيبُ الأَسْنَانِ ('the dentist').
Feminine: طَبِيبَة أَسْنَان (ṭabībat ʾasnān); masculine/mixed plural: أَطِبَّاء أَسْنَان (ʾaṭibbāʾ ʾasnān).

senses.definition: A doctor who treats people's teeth and gums.
